# formbro

Version `1.9.4`.

Canadian immigration form automation via the bundled FormBro CLI: import cases from external files through JSON contracts, read/write entities, validate, fill IMM PDFs, and drive local webform fills.

Platforms: macOS Apple Silicon (`darwin-arm64`), Windows x64 (`win32-x64`).

Load [`skills/formbro/SKILL.md`](skills/formbro/SKILL.md) first. Connect and product verbs are defined there and under `skills/formbro/references/`.

This package is an **Agent Skills** tree plus a native CLI. Any agent that can attach a skill folder or this full plugin directory can use it — marketplace `plugin install` is optional convenience, not a requirement.

- Full tree (preferred): this directory, including `bin/` and `runtime-manifest.json`, then `bin/<platform>/<cli> doctor --repair-install`.
- Skill-only attach: only after `~/.jackyzhang.app/plugins/formbro/current` already holds the matching CLI.

What changed in this version: [`skills/formbro/references/whats-new.md`](skills/formbro/references/whats-new.md).
